nodes.label: Shadow.vert (2D shadow pass vertex shader)
nodes.rationale: Renders opaque scene geometry depth-only from a light's point of view into one of the 2D shadow maps; reads the light's view-projection matrix from a push constant.

nodes.label: One per-instance UBO shared by four shaders
nodes.rationale: The same DSLlocal buffer is declared field-for-field in PosNormUV.vert, CookTorrance.frag, Shadow.vert and ShadowCube.vert (at set 1 in the main pass, set 0 in the shadow passes), so a moving occluder's re-mapped Wm makes its shadow follow it with no second buffer.

nodes.label: Occluder set: opaque instances only, flames excluded
nodes.rationale: Both shadow passes run over every opaque scene instance drawn with the CookTorrance technique; the flame billboards are deliberately not drawn as occluders, since an emissive translucent billboard should not cast a silhouette.
